proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9875.2 *maricca explicitly gives Bhojpuri maricā “chillies”, Awadhi mircā, Punjabi mirc/marc and Gujarati marcī/marcũ “red pepper”. Retained c selects this strengthened branch, distinct from marīca > miri and the marucca branch. Capsicum is a later semantic extension, not an ancient plant identification.

records.Source: brightbill-turner2007dogri[Appendix B, printed p. 27, item 75, Batote]

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5679 traces hot adjectives through Pali/Prakrit tatta, with Hindi tātā, Marwari tāto and Gujarati tātũ. The pt > tt > t development provides direct support.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2333 *uppari gives Punjabi uppar, Hindi ūpar, Gujarati upar, and eastern upari/upara “above”. The link is to this adverbial formation, rather than a similarly shaped adjective.

records.Source: brightbill-turner2007dogri[Appendix B, printed p. 27, item 146, Batote]
